title: The Lighthouse Fox
title_it: Il guardiano del faro e la volpe
hook: Every night, the old lighthouse keeper left one window lit.
caption:
Every night, he left one window lit. Not for the ships. 🦊🏮

A tiny paper-cut tale about who keeps the light for whom.
